projectDescription: WhatsApp and Telegram automation platform for SMM panel operators that lets customers submit refill, partial, speed-up, and cancel commands via chat while verifying order ownership through Perfect Panel.
keyFeatures: WhatsApp automation via Baileys — customers send commands directly in chat
Order ownership verification through Perfect Panel Admin API before any action
Refill command — trigger a refill on completed orders and notify the upstream provider
Partial command — provide partial-fill estimates for orders
Speed-up command — escalate active orders to the provider or estimate partials
Multi-tenant Spaces — each operator gets an isolated workspace
Trusted Senders — whitelist WhatsApp numbers for elevated permissions
Support Groups — route provider notifications to WhatsApp groups
Service Tracker — monitor order statuses across providers
Broadcast & Auto-poster — send bulk messages or scheduled posts through connected channels
AI Support with customizable knowledge base and ticket system
Dashboard with customer, message, and report views
publicApiSurface: Panel API settings — connect Perfect Panel Admin API key and base URL
Provider configuration — add and manage upstream suppliers
Channel management — connect and manage WhatsApp / Telegram accounts
Trusted Senders list — grant elevated access to specific numbers
Support Groups — configure WhatsApp groups for provider notifications
Broadcast API — send mass messages to customers
Knowledge Base API — manage AI support articles
Webhook events — Telegram webhook endpoint for incoming commands
